annotation.bound_parties_text: The standard is intended for use by sUAS manufacturers, sUAS operators, and CAAs, but it is a voluntary test method that imposes no obligations on them.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The test method is intended to be used by sUAS manufacturers, sUAS operators, and CAAs to assess the safety of sUA impacts to people on the ground
annotation.legal_effect_quote: Results from testing using Methods A, B, C, or D are intended to be used to support an applicant in obtaining permission from the governing Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) for flight over people.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: ASTM F3389/F3389M-21 Standard Test Method for Assessing the Safety of Small Unmanned Aircraft Impacts
